Name: The Hollow Harvest
Author: ywzenix
TagLine: A horror mod that slowly seeps into the cozy world of Stardew Valley. The first year everything is normal. The second year you notice something is wrong. The third year there is no escape.
Description:
The Hollow Harvest

Welcome to Pelican Town. You moved to your grandfather's farm, planted your crops, and met the villagers. Everything is fine.

For now.

Cursed Season adds a creeping unease to Stardew Valley without breaking its charming and relaxing loop. This is not a jumpscare collection. This is a story mod about a familiar town changing over time, villagers hiding something, and an old curse waking beneath your farm.

A Transformation Across Years
Year 1: Everything seems normal. Just a few small oddities, a few missing letters, a few shadows that linger too long.

Year 2: Villager dialogue changes. Some nights they do not leave their homes. Whispers spread through town. New sounds echo in the mines.

Year 3: The curse can no longer hide. The true face of Pelican Town is revealed. Cults, rituals, lost souls, and something awakening in the deeper levels.

Features
Dynamic Unease System: Weather, sounds, music, NPC behavior, and dialogue change as the game progresses.

Night Events: Shadows on your farm, new entities in the mines, secret rituals in town.

Mystery and Exploration: Notes, corpses, hidden rooms, and clues about the origin of the curse.

Choices and Multiple Endings: Break the curse, inherit it, or flee. Your decisions change the fate of the town.

Adjustable Horror: Mild, Normal, and Nightmare modes. You can completely disable jumpscares.

English Language Support: All new dialogue and interface text are in English.

SMAPI and Content Patcher Compatible: Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+.

Warnings
This mod contains sudden sounds, jumpscares, psychological horror, blood, death, and cult themes. It may be disturbing. You can lower the horror level or disable jumpscares in the settings.

Installation
Install SMAPI.

Install Content Patcher.

Download this mod and extract it into the Mods folder.

Launch the game through SMAPI.

Backing up your existing save is recommended. For the best experience, start a new save.

Compatibility
Fully compatible with vanilla Stardew Valley.

Compatibility patches for Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp are planned.

May conflict with other large content mods. Check for patches based on your mod list.

FAQ
Does it work on my existing save?
Yes, but a new save is recommended for the story flow.

Are there jumpscares?
Yes, but they can be disabled in the settings.

Does it work on consoles?
No. This mod is for PC only (Windows/Mac/Linux).

Is it in English?
Yes, English is included along with several other languages.

Credits
Thanks to the developers of SMAPI and Content Patcher, the modding community, and everyone who provided feedback.

Author's Note:
Playing this mod with sound on is recommended... but turn it down if you are scared. Something is wrong in Pelican Town.

Have fun. And be careful.
